description: An unreached restored query does not exclude ordinary finite recursive proofs (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x(X)
%conditions ~recursive ⊆ tags($x, q)
%rule q $y(r)
%conditions text($) = "x" ∨ matches(without-elision($y), rival)
%rule r r [+U] <~recursive> | X <∅>
%rule rival X
